RESEARCH CHAMBER
PRIMARY USER: KRELIAN
GUIDANCE LINK ACTIVE<New><Elly>
"This is Krelian's
laboratory... The Mass
Driver guidance line ends
here."<New><Emeralda>
"Then this is last room?"<New><Elly>
"The final console is
ahead. Stay close."<Close>

OUROBOROS RESEARCH CHAMBER
ARCHIVE DIRECTORY
PRIMARY USER: KRELIAN
REFERENCE ACCESS: SEALED<New>SUBJECT INDEX
OUROBOROS RING RECURRENCE
MIANG / REFERENCE FILE
INTRON PATTERN ANALYSIS<New>VISUAL LOG: NOT RECORDED
ANALYSIS FILES INCOMPLETE<New><Elly>
"Only the index survived.
Whatever Krelian found
about Miang and the
Ouroboros Ring is gone."<Close>

FINAL LAUNCH CONSOLE
GUIDANCE LINK LOCKED
CENTRAL AUTHORITY MISSING<New>Return to Central Control.
Complete launch authorization
before using this console.<New><Elly>
"The capsule cannot be
released from here yet."<Close>

FINAL LAUNCH CONSOLE
CAPSULE LINK CONFIRMED
GUIDANCE CONTROL READY
MANUAL COMMIT REQUIRED<New><Citan>
"Elly. The ascent path is
drifting, but I can hold it."<New><Elly>
"So that red tunnel was the
last service route."<New><Citan>
"Yes. This chamber has a
direct guidance link. I can
steady the solution here."<New><Citan>
"The capsule will open in
the upper atmosphere. You
must release it."<New><Elly>
"Then hold the path for me."<New>GUIDANCE LOCKED
MAGNETIC BANKS SYNCHRONIZED
CAPSULE ASCENT READY<New><Citan>
"Trajectory is stable.
Commit the capsule now!"<New><Elly>
"Please... reach everyone."<Close>

LAUNCH STATUS
LAUNCH COMPLETE
CAPSULE CLEAR
ATMOSPHERIC DISPERSAL ACTIVE<New>CAPSULE ALREADY RELEASED
NO SECOND PAYLOAD LOADED<New><Elly>
"It is done..."<New><Citan>
"The dispersal pattern is
stable. There is nothing
more to launch here."<Close>

EAST ACCESS DOOR
RED SERVICE TUNNEL
ROUTE TO CENTRAL CONTROL<New><Elly>
